class.name: HairGroom
class.brief_description: Hair as strands: polylines grown from a scalp.
class.description: A [HairGroom] holds hair strands as polylines of points, root first. Draw it with a [HairMesh]. Build one with [method grow_on_mesh], read one from Cem Yuksel's HAIR file format with [method load_hair_file], or fill [member points] and [member strand_point_counts] from a script.

method.name: get_point_count
method.description: Returns the number of points in all strands.

method.name: grow_on_mesh
method.description: Replaces the strands with [param count] strands of [param length] metres and [param points_per_strand] points, grown from surface [param surface] of [param mesh]. Roots are spread by area over the triangles where [param mask] (optional, sampled at the mesh's UV) is above one half. Each strand leaves the surface along its normal, combed away from [param crown] by [param comb] ([code]0[/code] straight out, [code]1[/code] flat along the surface), falls under [param droop] ([code]0[/code] stiff, [code]1[/code] limp), curls in a helix of [param curl_radius] metres with [param curls_per_metre] turns per metre, and wanders by [param frizz]. Strands are kept outside the ellipsoid that fits the surface's bounds, a stand-in for the head. Records each root's triangle and barycentric coordinates in [member root_triangles] and [member root_barycentrics]. Returns [code]false[/code] if no triangle can grow hair.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [member strand_point_counts] adds up to the number of [member points].

method.name: load_hair_file
method.description: Replaces the strands with those in a file in Cem Yuksel's HAIR format. Points are multiplied by [param scale] and turned from the format's Z-up to Y-up when [param z_up] is [code]true[/code]. Per-point thickness, transparency and colour in the file are ignored.

members.member: Every strand's points, root first, one strand after another.
For each strand, where in its [member root_triangles] triangle it grows. Empty when the strands were not grown on a mesh.
For each strand, the triangle of the scalp surface it grows from. Empty when the strands were not grown on a mesh.
The number of points in each strand.
